newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish agency wins $10 mln Miller ad contract.
newsitem.headline: Irish agency wins $10 mln Miller ad contract.

text.p: The Helme Partnership, a Dublin-based advertising agency, said on Wednesday that it had won a contract to create a $10 million Europe-wide advertising campaign for the Miller Brewing Company, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc.
The contract, to create the multi-media advertising for Miller Genuine Draft across Europe in 1997, is one of the largest ever awarded to an Irish firm for a Europe-wide campaign.
It was won against stiff competition from two British agencies, Helme said in a statement.
